Russia-Ukraine Conflict: Attacks and Retaliations Intensify

Russia launched missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, resulting in civilian casualties and damage to residential buildings. In response, Ukraine reported drone strikes on three Russian refineries and tankers. Russia subsequently announced a ban on diesel exports until July 31 to ensure domestic supply, impacting global fuel markets.
